data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 10.8 million in 2015, primarily due to favorable claims development and IBNR recalibration for the 2011, 2012, and 2013 underwriting years. The 2014 year of account, while not included in the prior year development calculation for 2015, saw mixed developments with large losses in Marine & Energy and Property, and market losses in Aviation, partially offset by positive developments in the North American Binders book, leading to a strengthened reserving position for that year.
